summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new features: Ticket Timeline, Contract Management, RMA Management UI, and Technician Performance Reports. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all major features including Ticket Timeline tab with event history, Contract Management page with CRUD operations, RMA page with progress bars, and Reports page with Teknisyenler tab.
critical_code_review_comments: All new feature APIs are properly implemented with authentication
Ticket Timeline correctly aggregates events from multiple sources (comments, status changes, assignments, SLA pauses, attachments, work orders)
Contract Management has full CRUD with proper validation and expiring contracts endpoint
RMA Management displays progress bar showing status stages (Beklemede → Onay → Kargo → Teslim → Tamamlandı)
Technician Performance Report shows comprehensive metrics including assigned tickets, completed work orders, total time, and average resolution time
All UI components have proper Turkish localization
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Sözleşme contract during UI testing. Backend tests created multiple test contracts (TEST_Yıllık Bakım Sözleşmesi, TEST_Get Contract Test, TEST_Update Contract Test, TEST_Delete Contract Test) which were cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features are working correctly. Backend tests cover: Ticket History/Timeline endpoint, Contract CRUD operations, Contract expiring list, RMA list with progress fields, Technician Performance reports (list and detail), SLA Profiles for contract integration. Frontend tests verified: Ticket detail page with Zaman Çizelgesi tab showing events, Sözleşme Yönetimi page with summary cards and contract creation dialog, RMA Yönetimi page with progress bars and detail view, Raporlar page with Teknisyenler tab showing performance metrics.
